videos.title: Outstanding Speaker Distinction: National Capital Markets Debate Competition
videos.description: Mr Astone Mwamba known as Mwewa Mwewa Demonstrated exceptional public speaking, strategic policy analysis, and persuasive advocacy at the National Capital Markets Debate Competition hosted by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
videos.details: Demonstrated exceptional public speaking, strategic policy analysis, and persuasive advocacy at the National Capital Markets Debate Competition hosted by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Recognized as the Overall Best Speaker at the Provincial Level, followed by commanding performances on the national stage to earn Overall Best Speaker honors in both the Quarter-Finals and the Grand Finals. Through rigorous arguments on economic governance, capital markets development, and investor protection, consistently delivered high-impact, evidence-based presentations that earned top ratings from judges across every competitive stage.

videos.title: LOCAL NEWS | YOUTH & ENTREPRENEURSHIP
videos.description:
1st Muchinga Youth Summit Concludes in Chinsali with Call for Innovation and Strategic Market Visibility
CHINSALI, ZAMBIA — The inaugural Muchinga Youth Summit 2026 officially concluded in Chinsali, drawing dynamic young leaders, entrepreneurs, and key institutional stakeholders from across the province to address critical pathways for youth-led economic transformation.
videos.details:
Delivering a keynote address at the event, corporate strategist and youth advocate Mr Astone Mwamba know as Mwewa Mwewa urged young people across Muchinga Province to cultivate an innovative mindset and strategically position themselves within an increasingly competitive marketplace.

Speaking to an audience of emergent innovators and student leaders, Mwamba emphasized that long-term community impact relies on strategic self-positioning, continuous skill adaptation, and proactive market visibility.

"Innovation is no longer optional—it is the defining metric for success in today's economy," Mr Mwewa stated. "Young people must move beyond traditional frameworks to build scalable solutions, establish strong brand visibility, and position themselves as indispensable drivers of value in competitive markets."

The landmark gathering featured prominent institutional leaders and regional executive delegates who shared policy insights, financial inclusion mechanisms, and social protection frameworks designed to support youth initiatives. Notable guest speakers alongside Mwamba included:

Muchinga Youth development Coordinator 
Regional Manager, National Pension Scheme Authority (NAPSA)
Regional Manager, National Health Insurance Management Authority (NHIMA)
Executive Leadership, Ubuntu Youth Network

The panellists collectively emphasized the necessity of inter-sectoral collaboration, combining institutional backing with grassroots youth enterprise to accelerate sustainable development across Muchinga Province.
